justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/UncheckedFilterReader.java`, `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/UncheckedFilterReaderTest.java`, and `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/UncheckedBufferedReaderTest.java`. The class is a small wrapper around `FilterReader` with limited outgoing dependencies (`AbstractStreamBuilder`, `Uncheck`, `Reader`, `IOException`, `UncheckedIOException`, `CharBuffer`) and a few delegated methods. Repository-wide search found no other production classes referencing it; the only direct uses are its own test class and a Javadoc reference in `UncheckedBufferedReaderTest`, so fan-in is low and it is not a dependency hub.
